# Doppel 2.3.0
- Claude instances keep up with Claude. When the Claude app updates itself, Doppel notices the instances it left behind and offers to rebuild them from the menu bar panel, with a progress bar, the same way ChatGPT updates already work. Settings › Updates now shows Claude beside ChatGPT. - Claude instances bring over your Code history by themselves. Sign in and open Code once, and the next launch copies the sessions for that same account and workspace from the original Claude app. Import… in the instance window still does it on demand. - Tinted Claude icons now follow dark mode, with a dark tile and a tinted star. An existing Claude instance picks up the new icon the next time it is rebuilt.

# Doppel 2.2.1
- The in-app browser works in your ChatGPT instances again. ChatGPT 26.1029 changed how its computer-use tool starts, and every browser request from an instance failed with "native pipe closed before response". Instances rebuild themselves with the fix the next time they open.

# Doppel 2.2.0
- Each ChatGPT and Claude instance now has a Browser section with its own Chrome profile. The profile stays tied to the instance when you rename it, and your main Chrome is not touched. Claude One, for example, gets a Claude Code launch command that uses its own configuration folder. - You confirm that the app and its browser are signed in to the same account before Doppel shows connection steps or pairs the ChatGPT extension. Existing standalone profiles are kept and can be linked to an instance once the profile is closed. Doppel never deletes browser data. - The profile that runs on the official ChatGPT app is now called the official engine, and `doppel engine` replaces `doppel browser` (the old name still works). That profile is the only one that can use appshots and Computer history, because ChatGPT only accepts those from its own signed app. The in-app browser works in every instance.
